name: Kasuga Misaki
source: Misaki is a 1st year student and president of the Gardening Club. Modest, quiet and as gentle as she is with her flowers in the courtyard, she treasures her friendship with Yuu and works earnestly to bloom the tulips [spoiler]left by her father.[/spoiler]
translation: Misaki is a 1st year student and president of the Gardening Club. Modest, quiet and as gentle as she is with her flowers in the courtyard, she treasures her friendship with Yuu and works earnestly to bloom the tulips [spoiler]left by her father.[/spoiler]
